_comment: Hand-curated INPUT. start/end are the researched (approximate) dates; scripts/event_engine.py snaps them to the price data. Descriptions deliberately contain no figures: every number on the pages is measured. direction = the move the event is about (down: peak to trough, up: trough to peak).

description.en: US stocks peaked in late April and slid through early summer as the Greek debt crisis spread fears across the euro zone. The market bottomed in early July once European rescue measures were in place and US data softened.
description.zh: 美股在四月下旬见顶，随后在希腊债务危机引发的欧元区担忧中一路回调。欧洲救助机制到位、美国经济数据转弱之后，市场在七月初触底。

description.en: On one afternoon in early May the Dow dropped sharply within minutes in a selling cascade amid thin liquidity, then recovered most of it the same day. It led to new circuit-breaker rules. In daily closes it sits inside the wider spring correction.
description.zh: 五月初的一个下午，道指在几分钟内急跌，流动性稀薄加上连锁抛售，当天又收回大部分跌幅，事后交易所推出了新的熔断规则。在日线收盘价上，它只是春季回调的一部分。

name.zh: 2011年阿拉伯之春油价飙升（利比亚）

description.en: Protests and civil war in Libya cut crude output and pushed oil sharply higher through the first months of the year. Higher energy costs also lifted food and commodity prices across the broader complex.
description.zh: 利比亚的抗议和内战压缩了原油产量，油价在年初几个月大幅走高。能源成本上升也带动了食品和整个大宗商品板块。

description.en: Silver ran to a near-record high in late April and then gave back a large part of its value within weeks. The fall was amplified by higher exchange margin requirements and a speculative unwind after the metal's parabolic run.
description.zh: 白银在四月下旬冲到接近历史纪录的高位，随后几周内大幅回落。交易所提高保证金要求，加上抛物线式上涨之后的投机盘平仓，放大了跌幅。

description.en: After a contentious debt-ceiling fight, S&P cut the US sovereign credit rating in August while the euro-zone debt crisis deepened. US stocks slid from their July high and bottomed in early October.
description.zh: 美国债务上限僵局之后，标普在八月下调美国主权信用评级，同期欧元区债务危机也在恶化。美股从七月高点一路下滑，十月初见底。

description.en: Gold set a record in early September on fears about sovereign debt and currency debasement. It then slid into year-end as the dollar firmed and the crisis-driven bid faded.
description.zh: 黄金在九月初因主权债务和货币贬值担忧创下纪录，随后随着美元走强、避险买盘退潮，一路下滑到年底。

description.en: The worst US drought in decades damaged the corn and soybean crops during the summer. Grain prices surged to record levels and lifted the agriculture complex.
description.zh: 美国遭遇数十年来最严重的干旱，夏季玉米和大豆减产。谷物价格大幅上涨，带动整个农产品板块走高。

description.en: Gold lost its footing in April with a very heavy one-day drop and kept sliding to multi-year lows, with heavy ETF selling. A firmer dollar, better US data and forced liquidations drove it.
description.zh: 黄金在四月出现单日大幅下挫，随后继续下探到数年新低，ETF 抛售沉重。美元走强、美国数据改善和被动平仓是主要推手。

description.en: The Fed's signal in May that it could slow its bond purchases sent bond yields sharply higher and hit gold and emerging markets. Gold reached multi-year lows by late June as the market priced in tapering.
description.zh: 美联储在五月暗示可能放缓购债，国债收益率大幅上行，黄金和新兴市场都受到冲击。到六月下旬，市场提前消化缩减购债，黄金跌到数年低点。

description.en: Crude peaked in mid 2014 and then collapsed for well over a year as US shale output surged and OPEC refused to cut production. The collapse hit energy shares and spread to broad commodity indices.
description.zh: 原油在二零一四年年中见顶，随后一年多持续崩跌：美国页岩油产量激增，欧佩克拒绝减产。这场下跌冲击能源股，并蔓延到整个大宗商品指数。

description.en: In mid January the Swiss National Bank abruptly abandoned its cap on the franc against the euro, throwing currency markets into disorder. The euro was already sliding against the dollar as the ECB prepared large-scale bond buying.
description.zh: 一月中旬，瑞士央行突然放弃瑞郎兑欧元的上限，外汇市场一度大乱。当时欧元兑美元本就在下行，欧洲央行正准备大规模购债。

name.zh: 2015年8月中国人民币贬值与股市抛售

description.en: China's surprise yuan devaluation in August raised fears about the world's second-largest economy. US stocks plunged on one wild Monday and commodities slumped further.
description.zh: 八月中国意外让人民币贬值，引发了市场对这个全球第二大经济体的担忧。美股在一个周一暴跌，大宗商品进一步走弱。

description.en: Global stocks began the year with a sharp decline driven by China growth fears, falling oil and a weak yuan. US stocks bottomed in mid February before recovering.
description.zh: 全球股市年初大幅下挫，原因是对中国增长的担忧、油价下跌和人民币走弱。美股在二月中旬见底后回升。

description.en: The UK voted to leave the European Union in the June referendum. Sterling plunged, the euro and global stocks dropped, and gold rose as investors looked for havens.
description.zh: 六月英国公投决定退出欧盟。英镑暴跌，欧元和全球股市下挫，黄金因避险买盘走高。

name.zh: 2017年比特币泡沫及2018年加密寒冬

description.en: Bitcoin peaked in December during a retail-driven boom and ether followed a similar path. Prices then fell for a full year as exchanges were hacked, regulation tightened and interest faded.
description.zh: 比特币在十二月的散户狂热中见顶，以太坊走势类似。此后一整年价格持续下跌，交易所被盗、监管收紧、热度退去。

description.en: A spike in volatility in early February forced the unwinding of short-volatility products, which amplified the sell-off. US stocks fell sharply from their late-January record.
description.zh: 二月初波动率飙升，迫使做空波动率的产品平仓，放大了抛售。美股从一月底的纪录高位急跌。

description.en: Rising US rates, the US-China trade dispute and slowing growth drove US stocks down from their September peak to a Christmas Eve low. Oil also fell sharply in the fourth quarter.
description.zh: 美国利率上行、中美贸易争端和增长放缓，把美股从九月高点一路压到平安夜前后的低点。第四季度油价也大幅下跌。

description.en: Washington and Beijing escalated tariffs in early August and China let the yuan weaken past a key level. US stocks fell sharply while gold rose as a haven.
description.zh: 八月初中美互相加征关税，中国也让人民币跌破关键关口。美股大幅下挫，黄金作为避险资产走高。

name.zh: 2019年9月沙特阿美遇袭油价飙升

description.en: Drone and missile strikes on Saudi Arabia's main oil facilities knocked out a large part of its output for a time. Oil jumped by the largest one-day gain in years, then retraced as supply was restored.
description.zh: 无人机和导弹袭击沙特主要石油设施，一度使其很大一部分产量中断。油价单日涨幅为多年来之最，随着供应恢复又回吐。

description.en: Pandemic lockdowns around the world caused the fastest bear market on record in US stocks. Oil collapsed on demand fears, while gold and bitcoin were sold for cash in the liquidity crunch.
description.zh: 新冠疫情在全球引发封锁，美股经历了有记录以来最快的一轮熊市。需求担忧让油价崩跌，黄金和比特币也在流动性紧缩中被抛售换现金。

description.en: Gold rallied from its March low to a record high in early August. Ultra-low interest rates, massive central-bank stimulus and fears about currency debasement drove the rise.
description.zh: 黄金从三月低点一路上涨，八月初创下历史新高。超低利率、央行大规模刺激和对货币贬值的担忧推动了这轮上涨。

description.en: A lockdown-driven demand collapse and full storage pushed the front-month oil futures contract below zero in April. Futures-based funds such as USO suffered large losses and forced rolls.
description.zh: 封锁造成需求骤降、库存爆满，四月近月原油期货价格跌破零。USO 这类持有期货的基金损失惨重，并被迫提前换月。

description.en: Bitcoin plunged within weeks in May after China cracked down on mining and Tesla stopped accepting bitcoin for payments. Leveraged positions were liquidated across crypto markets.
description.zh: 五月中国打击挖矿、特斯拉停止接受比特币付款，比特币在几周内暴跌。整个加密市场的杠杆仓位被集中清算。

name.en: Crypto peak in November 2021 to 2022 lows
name.zh: 2021年11月加密货币高点至2022年低点

description.en: Bitcoin reached an all-time high in November 2021 and then entered a year-long bear market as rate hikes and the failures of Terra and large crypto funds drained liquidity.
description.zh: 比特币在二零二一年十一月创下历史新高，随后进入长达一年的熊市：加息，加上 Terra 和多家大型加密基金接连出事，抽干了流动性。

name.zh: 2021年奥密克戎变异株油价冲击

description.en: Reports of the Omicron variant in late November triggered fears of new travel restrictions, and oil dropped sharply in a day. US stocks also sold off that week as volatility rose.
description.zh: 十一月下旬奥密克戎变异株的消息引发对新一轮出行限制的担忧，油价一天内大幅下挫。当周美股也随着波动率上升而下跌。

description.en: The Federal Reserve raised rates aggressively to fight inflation and pushed US stocks into a bear market from their January peak to a low in October. Growth and technology shares led the decline.
description.zh: 美联储为对抗通胀大幅加息，美股从一月高点一路进入熊市，十月见底。成长股和科技股领跌。

name.en: Russia's invasion of Ukraine commodity spike
name.zh: 俄乌冲突引发的大宗商品飙升

description.en: Russia invaded Ukraine in late February, and sanctions threatened supplies of oil, gas, wheat and metals. Oil surged to multi-year highs before easing.
description.zh: 二月下旬俄罗斯入侵乌克兰，制裁威胁到石油、天然气、小麦和金属的供应。油价飙升到多年高位，随后回落。

description.en: The algorithmic stablecoin UST lost its dollar peg in May and the LUNA token collapsed to almost nothing. Bitcoin and ether fell sharply as contagion spread through crypto markets.
description.zh: 五月算法稳定币 UST 脱锚，LUNA 代币几乎归零。风险蔓延到整个加密市场，比特币和以太坊大幅下跌。

description.en: The euro slid toward parity with the dollar in the summer as the Fed hiked faster than the ECB and Europe faced an energy shock. The pair touched its lowest level in about two decades.
description.zh: 夏天欧元兑美元逼近平价：美联储加息比欧洲央行更快，欧洲又面临能源冲击。汇率触及约二十年来的低点。

description.en: After Russia cut pipeline gas to Europe, gas prices spiked to extreme levels in late summer. Prices then collapsed over a mild winter as storage refilled and demand fell.
description.zh: 俄罗斯削减对欧洲的管道天然气之后，气价在夏末飙到极端水平。随后暖冬、库存回补、需求下降，价格一路崩落。

description.en: A report on FTX's balance sheet in early November led to a run on the exchange, which halted withdrawals and filed for bankruptcy. Bitcoin and ether fell further as the fallout hit trading firms and lenders.
description.zh: 十一月初一份关于 FTX 资产负债表的报道引发挤兑，平台暂停提现并申请破产。冲击波及交易公司和借贷机构，比特币和以太坊进一步下跌。

description.en: Silicon Valley Bank failed in March after a run on deposits triggered by bond losses, and regional banks came under heavy pressure. Investors rushed toward havens and bet on earlier rate cuts.
description.zh: 三月硅谷银行因债券亏损引发挤兑而倒闭，区域性银行受到沉重压力。投资者涌向避险资产，并押注更早降息。

description.en: Gold climbed from the start of 2024 to successive record highs in 2025. Central-bank buying, geopolitical tension and expectations of Fed rate cuts drove the rally.
description.zh: 黄金从二零二四年初一路上涨，在二零二五年接连创下历史新高。央行购金、地缘紧张和对美联储降息的预期推动了这轮行情。

name.zh: 2024年比特币现货ETF获批推动的上涨

description.en: US regulators approved spot bitcoin ETFs in January and inflows were strong from the first days. Bitcoin set a new all-time high in March.
description.zh: 一月美国监管机构批准现货比特币 ETF，资金从最初几天起就大量流入。比特币在三月创下新的历史高点。

description.en: A Bank of Japan rate hike at the end of July, together with weak US jobs data, forced an unwind of yen carry trades. Volatility spiked on the first Monday of August and US stocks and bitcoin fell hard before recovering.
description.zh: 七月底日本央行加息，加上美国就业数据疲弱，迫使日元套利交易平仓。八月第一个周一波动率飙升，美股和比特币大幅下跌，随后很快收复。

description.en: A low-cost Chinese AI model raised doubts about US AI spending and hit chip stocks in late January. Broader US stocks fell only modestly while tech and crypto were hit harder.
description.zh: 一月下旬，一款低成本的中国 AI 模型让市场对美国 AI 投入产生疑问，芯片股大跌。美股大盘跌幅有限，科技股和加密货币受冲击更大。

description.en: Sweeping US tariffs announced in early April triggered a global sell-off. Gold and bitcoin both rose at times as investors searched for havens, before a partial policy reversal.
description.zh: 四月初美国宣布大范围关税，引发全球抛售。投资者寻找避险资产，黄金和比特币一度上涨，随后政策出现部分反转。

description.en: Bitcoin peaked in early October and a sharp leveraged liquidation cascade erased large amounts of derivatives positions. Prices then drifted lower into late November.
description.zh: 比特币在十月初见顶，随后一轮杠杆清算潮抹掉了大量衍生品仓位。价格在十一月下旬前持续下行。
